lines.text: This is Math Explorer, a Star Learner game that makes math visible. Every number is a set of blocks you can count, and every answer is spoken out loud.

Across the bottom: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, each with a block tutorial and endless practice. And three games of their own: chickens and eggs, two trains, and the coin counter.

Every operation has a block tutorial. She counts red blocks, watches four slide away for take-away, sees three groups of four become twelve, and shares nine blocks into three buckets. The blocks do the teaching.

The games are little movies she can play. Hens lay their eggs and she drags them into nests and cartons. Two trains race, and she answers how far ahead the fast one gets. Pennies, nickels, and dimes make the amount.

Practice mode asks fresh questions forever, with blocks to count and three big answers to choose from. A wrong answer is never just wrong. The blocks slowly count themselves out, so she sees exactly why.
Math Explorer. Numbers she can see, touch, and count. Ready to play on the Star Learner console.
